d: Deep crimson, layered hair with long, flowing strands and choppy bangs frames a youthful, mature face with narrow, glowing gold eyes. The slender build is dressed in a red cropped jacket over a bare torso, paired with high-waisted white flared trousers featuring red buckle straps and white ruffles along the outer seams. A red newsboy cap sits atop the head, while a small black cat perches on a dark blue rectangular sign held in the arms.
